description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Trading Community product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: Party Search UI).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Trading Community.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Trading Community. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 8.1 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).
